# Naqash Thaheem

> Technical Project Manager | AI Automation, SEO & Business Systems Specialist based in the United Arab Emirates. Helps businesses plan, automate, integrate, test, and deliver digital systems.

Site: https://naqashthaheem.com
Contact: contact@naqashthaheem.com
Location: United Arab Emirates (works with clients remotely)

Positioning: Business + Project Management + Technology + Quality. Combines technical project management, AI and n8n automation, CRM implementation, technical SEO, QA/test automation and SaaS product delivery into one delivery framework.

## Services

- [Technical Project Management](https://naqashthaheem.com/services/technical-project-management): requirements, charter, WBS, sprints, risk, vendor coordination, UAT, deployment, closure.
- [AI & Automation](https://naqashthaheem.com/services/ai-automation): WhatsApp AI agents, lead qualification, proposal generation, n8n workflows, business process automation.
- [SEO & Organic Growth](https://naqashthaheem.com/services/seo-organic-growth): technical SEO audits, keyword research, search intent, competitor analysis, on-page SEO, SEO QA with Playwright.
- [CRM & Business Systems](https://naqashthaheem.com/services/crm-business-systems): Zoho CRM, HubSpot, Bitrix24 pipelines, data models, automation, dashboards.
- [QA & Test Automation](https://naqashthaheem.com/services/qa-test-automation): Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, Pytest, API testing, regression and release validation.
- [SaaS & Product Development](https://naqashthaheem.com/services/saas-product-development): requirements, feature planning, integration, QA, deployment, onboarding.

## Case studies

- [CloudPOS4U](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/cloudpos4u-restaurant-pos-saas): restaurant POS SaaS; Selenium/Pytest automation with Page Objects, API testing, release validation.
- [Villas Olimpia](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/villas-olimpia-ai-booking-automation): villa booking MVP; Airbnb iCal sync, pricing rules engine, bilingual AI WhatsApp assistant with voice.
- [Recruitment ONE](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/recruitment-one-ai-talent-matching): Zoho CRM architecture, AI talent matching with OpenAI embeddings and Pinecone, Power BI.
- [AI Proposal Factory](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/ai-proposal-factory): HubSpot → n8n → AI-generated proposal PDFs, Drive storage, email and WhatsApp notifications.
- [AI Event Management Operating System](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/ai-event-management-operating-system): inquiry-to-staffing automation architecture.
- [Website Issue Lead Generation System](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/website-issue-lead-generation-system): technical website audits turned into CRM leads and outreach.
- [Lead Generation Operating System](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/lead-generation-operating-system): Apollo, Clay, HubSpot, n8n and AI scoring.
- [SocialAI Corporate Gifts](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/socialai-corporate-gifts): UAE business launch project.
- [Smart Tuition](https://naqashthaheem.com/case-studies/smart-tuition): education micro-business concept.
